objective: Resolve every pinned-baseline parity row into an approved, evidenced, cross-platform Product Contract disposition without treating the reference implementation as the specification.
completion_definition: The pinned baseline census is reviewed, signed, and closed.
Every parity-ledger row links to a stable Product Contract requirement; no contract field remains null.
Every manifest capability is approved or active and declares accepted Windows, macOS, and Linux dispositions.
Persisted formats and integrations have compatibility policy, fixtures, and runtime-observation evidence where applicable.
Conformance coverage traces normative requirements to independent evidence and all required human approvals are recorded.
No unresolved deviation, waiver, security review, privacy review, accessibility review, or product-owner decision remains unowned.

waves.title: Governance and baseline
waves.goal: Approve the census boundary, contract-writing rules, and existing draft disposition.

waves.title: Application and configuration
waves.goal: Specify application lifecycle, settings ownership, identity, secrets, and security behavior.

waves.title: Capture and workflow engine
waves.goal: Complete capture families and the execution semantics that compose them.

waves.title: Recording and media
waves.goal: Specify recording, encoding, playback, and media-editor behavior.

waves.title: Uploads and destinations
waves.goal: Define transfer behavior, destination surfaces, credentials, and compatible uploader data.

waves.title: History and indexing
waves.goal: Define task history, search, retention, thumbnails, and compatible history data.

waves.title: Automation interfaces
waves.goal: Define automation, CLI, MCP, and compatibility boundaries together.

waves.title: Settings catalog
waves.goal: Resolve the complete settings inventory and configuration compatibility policy.

waves.title: Workflow catalog
waves.goal: Resolve every inventoried workflow and action surface against stable behavior.

waves.title: GUI surfaces
waves.goal: Resolve all remaining user-facing GUI surfaces, accessibility, and platform disposition.

waves.title: Operations and edge domains
waves.goal: Close diagnostics, distribution, experimental mobile, and image-effect compatibility decisions.

waves.title: Conformance and closure
waves.goal: Prove full traceability, cross-platform disposition, runtime compatibility, and approval closure.
